content.enriched_brief: Make a palace-intrigue, rise-from-the-ashes animated short drama. The female lead is a disgraced empress, depicted as a woman in a striking red, gold-embroidered imperial robe and an ornate peacock feather headdress adorned with pearls. She has climbed all the way back from the cold palace to the principal palace; the only one who still remembers her real name on this arduous revenge road is the loyal little eunuch who once took a knife for her. Add a sweeping classical-Chinese BGM.
